Since Fybot's departure from the Quor'sav homeworld&mdash;established to have been Uaua by {{GamerCite|5|A Campaign Guide to the Centrality}}&mdash;must have occurred at some point by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] per the aforementioned timeline information, and since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a tens-of-[[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]&ndash;old [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide government, was [[Declaration of a New Order|supplanted]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Uaua and its [[Star system/Legends|star system]] must have paid tribute to the Republic.</ref>
}}
{{Quote|What we have here is a giant nerfsteak coated in seasoned pom seed flour and pan-fried to perfection using an authentic recipe from Uaua.|Dexter Jettster, menu for Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>}}
'''Uaua''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Quor'sav/Legends|Quor'sav]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of tall, flightless [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] with [[Bird/Legends|avian]] and [[monotreme]] traits. After a [[Unidentified virus (Uaua)|virus]] accidentally introduced by off-world [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] nearly eliminated the Quor'sav, they developed a distrust for members of non-avian species.

The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] once obtained a recipe from Uaua for pan-frying a [[Nerf steak/Legends|nerf steak]], and as part of a tribute paid to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by Uaua's [[Ua system|star system]], the Quor'sav [[Waywa Fybot]] left his homeworld to become a [[Police officer/Legends|law enforcement officer]]. [[Standard decade/Legends|Decades]] later, Fybot revisited Uaua in a [[Dream/Legends|dream]] induced by the [[Flamewind of Oseon/Legends|Flamewind]] phenomenon of the [[Oseon system/Legends|Oseon system]].

==Description==
Uaua<ref name="TEA" /> was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="LCFO" /> that was the principal world of the [[Ua system]],<ref name="CSWE Uaua" /> a part of the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[Orbit/Legends|Orbiting]] a single [[Star/Legends|star]],<ref name="LCFO" /> it was situated on the [[Falko Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], which linked it to the [[Dilonexa system/Legends|Dilonexa]] and [[Falko system/Legends|Falko systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

The planet was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to [[Insect/Legends|insects]],<ref name="Gamer5" /> and [[Lawn louse|lawn lice]] could be found in at least [[Waywa Fybot's home|one local residence's]] [[Grass/Legends|lawn]]. At some point, Uaua was also inhabited by [[Bird/Legends|birds]], from which the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]<ref name="LCFO" /> [[Quor'sav/Legends|Quor'sav]]<ref name="CSWE Fybot">{{CSWECite|I|300|Fybot, Waywa}}</ref> eventually evolved.<ref name="LCFO" />

==History==
===The avian world===
[[File:KalFalnlCndros-SecretsOfTheSisarRun.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Uaua was the homeworld of the Quor'sav.]]
At some point, [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] from other parts of the Centrality,<ref name="Gamer5" /> mostly consisting of individuals of [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] [[Species/Legends|species]], accidentally introduced a [[Unidentified virus (Uaua)|virus]] on Uaua<ref name="CSWE Uaua" /> for which mammals served as immune carriers but which was [[Death/Legends|deadly]] to avian species. As a result, the native Quor'sav,<ref name="Gamer5" /> who nearly became extinct due to the virus,<ref name="CSWE Uaua" /> became distrustful of non-avian<ref name="Gamer5" />&mdash;particularly mammalian<ref name="CSWE Quor'sav">{{CSWECite|III|65|Quor'sav}}</ref>&mdash;visitors to their homeworld, and any such off-worlders ceased to be welcome on Uaua. In addition, even the local insects seemed to target off-world individuals with particular fierceness.<ref name="Gamer5" />

The Quor'sav were already known in the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|life/13328_4.html|Study: Pollution Standards Still Endanger Many}}</ref> by [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="HNNdate">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|life/13328_4.html|Study: Pollution Standards Still Endanger Many}} is set on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] "13:3:28," which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> at which point members of the species resided on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="HNN" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA" /> At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDate">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] had learned an authentic recipe from Uaua for pan-frying a [[Nerf steak/Legends|nerf steak]] "to perfection," a fact which Jettster noted in the description for the [[Quor'sav-fried steak]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] that formed a part of the menu at his Coruscant [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]].<ref name="Dex" />

===Home of a narcotics agent===
{{Quote|He was ''[&hellip;]'' conscripted to pay tribute owed by treaty by his system to the central galactic government.|[[Rokur Gepta]], to Lando Calrissian on Waywa Fybot while disguised as Bohhuah Mutdah|<ref name="LCFO" />}}
A [[Unidentified treaty|treaty]] was signed at some point which forced the<ref name="LCFO" /> Ua system<ref name="CSWE Uaua" /> to pay tribute to<ref name="LCFO" /> the Republic.<ref name="Republic" /> As part of the tribute, [[Waywa Fybot]], a local student of the [[Diet/Legends|culinary]] arts who was deemed talented by other<ref name="LCFO" /> Quor'sav,<ref name="CSWE Fybot" /> was conscripted in a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] and left his homeworld<ref name="LCFO" /> at some point by 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="Republic" /> In Fybot's view, his enjoyment of life diminished once he had left Uaua. During his ensuing career, which involved working as an undercover [[Spice/Legends|narcotics]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] in service to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Fybot sent [[Currency/Legends|checks]] to his family on Uaua.<ref name="LCFO" />

[[File:Flamewind-FlamewindOfOseon.jpg|thumb|right|300px|While the Quor'sav Waywa Fybot was traveling aboard the ''Millennium Falcon'' (upper right), the Flamewind phenomenon (center) caused him to experience a dream in which he visited Uaua.]]
Sometime between [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] and [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],<ref name="LCFOdate">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the [[Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures|''The Lando Calrissian Adventures'']] trilogy, of which ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'' is the second installment, to between [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] and [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].</ref> Fybot was traveling through the [[Oseon system/Legends|Oseon system]] aboard [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], during the local phenomenon known as the [[Flamewind of Oseon/Legends|Flamewind]] in order to arrest the retired trillionaire industrialist [[Bohhuah Mutdah/Legends|Bohhuah Mutdah]]. The Flamewind affected the perception and behavior of beings not protected by adequate shielding, with Fybot experiencing a [[Dream/Legends|dream]] in which he was transported back to Uaua. In the dream, while the Quor'sav was walking toward his hometown, he discovered that his vestigial [[Limb/Legends|wing]]-arms had been transformed into functional wings that allowed him to fly above the [[City/Legends|town]] and toward his former home. After having landed and entered the building, Fybot was enjoying a meal offered by his [[Parent/Legends|mother]] before the narcotics agent suddenly woke up from the dream.<ref name="LCFO" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Quor'sav/Legends}}
{{Quote|A gentle being, our Waywa; at heart he nurtures no ambition greater than to become a gourmet chef. ''[&hellip;]'' he possesses no small talent, in the view of his fellow avians ''[&hellip;]''<nowiki />|Rokur Gepta, to Lando Calrissian while disguised as Bohhuah Mutdah|<ref name="LCFO" />}}
Uaua was the homeworld of the Quor'sav,<ref name="TEA" /> a species of flightless sentients<ref name="CSWE Quor'sav" /> with both avian and [[monotreme]] characteristics.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Kal'Falnl C'ndros}}</ref> Averaging 3.5 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height,<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> members of the species included both [[Centipede/Legends|centipedes]]<ref name="LCFO" /> and [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] steaks in their diet.<ref name="Dex" /> At least two Quor'sav eventually found their way off-world.<ref name="LCFO" /><ref name="CCG" />

==Locations==
{{Main|Waywa Fybot's hometown}}
A moderately large [[Waywa Fybot's hometown|town]] was situated on Uaua. It included several roofed houses, including a large building inhabited by Waywa Fybot's family. The house was built out of [[Cement/Legends|cement]] and [[Steel/Legends|steel]] beams and had a thatched roof. A [[Color/Legends|magenta]]-colored lawn enclosed by a fence and populated by thousands of lawn lice lay adjacent to the house.<ref name="LCFO" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:A_Campaign_Guide_to_the_Centrality_G5.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Michael Kogge named Uaua for the article "A Campaign Guide to the Centrality."]]
Uaua was introduced in the [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] source article "[[A Campaign Guide to the Centrality]]," which was authored by [[Michael Kogge]] and was published in [[Star Wars Gamer 5|''Star Wars Gamer'' 5]]<ref name="Gamer5" /> on [[July 24]], [[2001]].<ref name="GamerDate">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20010627.html|text=''Gamer'' #5. A Domain of Evil it is.}}</ref> The article, which built on the<ref name="Gamer5" /> [[1983]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures|''The Lando Calrissian Adventures'']] trilogy of novels by [[L. Neil Smith]] and detailed the Centrality sector that was featured in that series, described the planet as the homeworld of the avian Quor'sav species.<ref name="Gamer5" />

It was not until the publication of [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', however, that Waywa Fybot,<ref name="CSWE Fybot" /> an avian character introduced in the second entry of Smith's trilogy, ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'',<ref name="LCFO" /> was established to have been a Quor'sav.<ref name="CSWE Fybot" /> Thereby, the passage from ''Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon'' in which Fybot visits his species' homeworld in a dream sequence was [[Retroactive continuity|retroactively]] established as the first appearance of Uaua.<ref name="LCFO" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed Uaua in grid square U-8.<ref name="TEA" />
